quality.basis: 第五类构建失败：注入的 Lua 绑定代码没有被构建，镜像里也没有 Lua

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: none: the exploit runs a copy of getnum cut out of wslua_struct.c with a stub lua_State; its format string is no input for any built program, and no built program contains wslua.

review.note: output differs (EXPLOIT_TRIGGERED vs NO_TRIGGER), no crash

category5.design: Unusable here: the change is in epan/wslua (the Lua bindings), which the OSS-Fuzz build does not compile (no Lua in the image), so the two builds are identical. A Lua-enabled driver would need Lua added to the image, which the judge cannot have. The spec keeps the fuzzshark_ip harness and the crash rule so the bundle exists and says why it is unusable.
